cases.name: invalid_patch
cases.trigger: sandbox.validate_patch returns SUCCEEDED with verdict REJECTED and exit_code 1
cases.oracle: The workflow stops before APPLYING_PATCH and preserves the validation error as evidence.

cases.name: tests_failed
cases.trigger: sandbox.run_tests returns SUCCEEDED with verdict REJECTED and exit_code 1
cases.oracle: The workflow stops before QUALITY_SCANNING and retains the failing test output.

cases.name: sonar_unavailable
cases.trigger: sandbox.run_quality returns SUCCEEDED with verdict REJECTED because required Sonar configuration or service is unavailable
cases.oracle: Missing quality evidence is blocking and can never be converted to a successful gate.

cases.name: blocking_vulnerability
cases.trigger: sandbox.run_security returns SUCCEEDED with verdict REJECTED after Trivy finds a HIGH or CRITICAL vulnerability
cases.oracle: The workflow stops before REVIEWING and keeps the Trivy evidence.

cases.name: approval_absent
cases.trigger: No valid human approval is recorded for the task
cases.oracle: The task remains immutable at the approval gate and no delivery operation starts.
cases.gap: Expiry, alteration and cryptographic binding of approval evidence are deferred to MCP-116 through MCP-120.

cases.name: pull_request_creation_retry
cases.trigger: The SCM call times out after a remote Pull Request may already have been created
cases.oracle: A retry discovers the existing branch and Pull Request using the idempotency key and returns the same URL; exactly one branch and one Pull Request exist.
cases.gap: The prototype has no resumable or idempotent SCM delivery yet; implementation and proof are tracked by MCP-115 and MCP-120.
